clips.transcript: Aurora Seven... Mission Control. The rescue vehicle has crashed. We lost it on final approach. I'm sorry. A second craft is already in transit. New rendezvous: mission day thirty-one. Conserve your supplies. We are not giving up on you.
Aurora Seven, rescue crew. We have you in sight. You've held on long enough. We're coming alongside. Stand by for docking.
Contact. Capture confirmed. Hard dock. Stay clear while we equalize the hatch. Aurora Seven... you're not alone anymore.
